checks.name: ReviewF7.closedSlabLimit_of_theorem71
checks.code:
/-- Every construction admitted by Section 8 has the continuous uniform
velocity limit asserted by the opening paragraph, including the terminal time.
The statement also records agreement with the smooth Euler solution before it. -/
theorem closedSlabLimit_of_theorem71
    {P : InductiveEulerParameters} {c : InductiveEulerConstruction P} {C T : ℝ}
    (h71 : Theorem71Conclusions c C T) :
    ∃ (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure) (w : Velocity),
      Proposition81Conclusions c T u p ∧
      ContinuousOn (Function.uncurry w) (Icc 0 T ×ˢ (univ : Set Vec3)) ∧
      TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n => Function.uncurry (c.stages.velocity n))
        (Function.uncurry w) atTop (Icc 0 T ×ˢ (univ : Set Vec3)) ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, u t = w t := by
  obtain ⟨u, p, h81⟩ := TorusEuler.Paper.proposition_8_1 P c C T h71
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hU, hagree⟩ :=
    TorusEuler.Paper.Lib.S678b.closedSlab_velocity_limit h71 h81
  exact ⟨u, p, w, h81, hw, hU, hagree⟩
checks.doc: Every construction admitted by Section 8 has the continuous uniform velocity limit asserted by the opening paragraph, including the terminal time. The statement also records agreement with the smooth Euler solution before it.

checks.name: ReviewF7.closedSlabSetting_of
checks.code:
theorem closedSlabSetting_of (h : Statement.Text.section8_setting) : ClosedSlabSetting := by
  obtain ⟨P, c, C, T, h71⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨_, _, w, _, hw, hU, _⟩ := closedSlabLimit_of_theorem71 h71
  exact ⟨P, c, C, T, w, h71, hw, hU⟩

checks.code:
theorem closedSlabSetting : ClosedSlabSetting :=
  closedSlabSetting_of TorusEuler.Paper.Text.section8_setting

end ReviewF7

checks.name: TorusEuler.Paper.Fidelity.transverseSolution_existsUnique
checks.code:
/-- Each zero-phase-mean source has exactly one normalized transverse solution. -/
theorem transverseSolution_existsUnique
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) {U : Velocity} {X : ℝ → Velocity} {k : Vec3}
    (d : ParentGeometry hT U X k) (f : HierarchyTwistedProfile T k Vec3)
    (hf : (S5.ops d).average f = 0) :
    ∃! z : HierarchyTwistedProfile T k Vec3 × HierarchyTwistedProfile T k ℝ,
      S5.TransverseSolution d f z.1 z.2 := by
  obtain ⟨V, q, hsol⟩ := Bridge.transverseSolvable d f hf
  refine ⟨(V, q), hsol, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨V', q'⟩ hsol'
  obtain ⟨hV, hq⟩ := Bridge.TransverseSolution.unique d hsol' hsol
  exact Prod.ext hV hq
checks.doc: Each zero-phase-mean source has exactly one normalized transverse solution.

checks.name: TorusEuler.Paper.Fidelity.lemma_5_3_with_unique_transverse_solution
checks.code:
/-- Lemma 5.3, accompanied by explicit existence and uniqueness for its
transverse solves. All estimates and their quantifier order remain those of
the authors' statement. -/
theorem lemma_5_3_with_unique_transverse_solution :
    Statement.lemma_5_3 ∧
      ∀ {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) {U : Velocity} {X : ℝ → Velocity} {k : Vec3}
        (d : ParentGeometry hT U X k) (f : HierarchyTwistedProfile T k Vec3),
        (S5.ops d).average f = 0 →
          ∃! z : HierarchyTwistedProfile T k Vec3 × HierarchyTwistedProfile T k ℝ,
            S5.TransverseSolution d f z.1 z.2 := by
  refine ⟨TorusEuler.Paper.lemma_5_3, ?_⟩
  intro T hT U X k d f hf
  exact transverseSolution_existsUnique hT d f hf

end TorusEuler.Paper.Fidelity
checks.doc: Lemma 5.3, accompanied by explicit existence and uniqueness for its transverse solves. All estimates and their quantifier order remain those of the authors' statement.
